features: Record rate 120 ips at 1080p, 240 ips at 720p or lower
Auto detection of HD-TVI and analog signals
Two-way audio, VMD, video obscuration detection, 2x-12x digital zoom on playback
notes: Spec sheet lists 2 internal SATA ports; A&E spec lists 4. Bay count left out.
Spec sheet gives 120 W consumption; A&E spec gives 80 W. Power consumption left out.
Spec sheet gives dimensions 430 x 88 x 405 mm; A&E spec gives 430 x 88 x 413 mm. Dimensions left out.
Spec sheet gives 8 alarm inputs / 4 outputs; A&E spec gives 8 inputs / 2 relay outputs. Alarm output count left out.
Spec sheet gives display speed up to 120 ips and 4-channel 1080p synchronous playback; A&E spec gives up to 240 ips and 4-channel 720p synchronous playback.
Spec sheet gives network throughput 30 ips @ D1; A&E spec gives remote data throughput 3 to 12 Mbps.
A&E spec states recording resolution up to 1080p; no megapixel figure is given.
